split_method: Whole source runs; related same-target 3338 and3770 calibration sessions grouped as calibration. No synthetic/mock images included. Held-out runs were visually labeled before recognition scores were examined; no fix derives from their pixels. Existing prior exposure by older development is possible: this is a development holdout, not a prospective population trial.
limitations: 77 genuine frames;26 held-out in two source runs, including25 correlated frames in one approach. Every saved failure used to design this fix is development data. Cannot demonstrate>=99% representative production accuracy.

label_revisions.reason: Magnification of original raster clearly shows both left vertical bands and no middle bar on last digit:0. Initial contact-sheet transcription was wrong. Correction did not change classifier.

all_real_asteroid_diversity.current_hp_damage_coverage: Current-HP decrease is synthetic regression coverage; this real corpus mainly contains pre-mining full-HP targets.

uncertainty.reason: 25 of26 frames are one correlated approach; only two HP identities and one client layout. Bound is illustrative and optimistic, not a valid production confidence claim.
uncertainty.needed: At least300 genuinely held-out representative frames from new natural production runs, varied HP digits, range, moving/stopped speeds and HUD backgrounds; freeze reader before scoring. Count false rejections and wrong accepted values as failures; retain run grouping and all inputs.
